title: Oct bank reconciliation – duplicate payment, same invoice paid twice

documents.text:
GlassCraft Industries Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-H101
Oct 2026 glass and glazing materials
Total: RM8,500.00
Payment received: RM8,500.00 on 5 Oct 2026
Status: PAID IN FULL

Payment Receipt REC-H01
From: Petronas Link Sdn Bhd
Date: 15 Oct 2026
Amount: RM22,000.00

Payroll Instruction PAY-H01
Oct 2026 salaries direct debit
Total net pay: RM15,000.00
Debit date: 28 Oct 2026

ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. Difference RM0.00. No adjustments required.

ground_truth.explanation: L2 and L4 both reference INV-H101 and are both paid to GlassCraft Industries for the same amount. INV-H101 confirms the invoice was PAID IN FULL on 5 Oct 2026, making the 18 Oct payment (L4/B4) a duplicate. Although the bank reconciliation balances numerically (both debits appear in both records), the source document reveals an overpayment of RM8,500 that must be recovered. The AI signed off without checking whether the same doc_ref appears twice.
